name: book-epub-project-en-zh-hans

scripts.translation:prebuild: npm run translation:contract:validate && npm run translation:units:validate:semantic && npm run translation:units:materialize
scripts.preflight:template: npm run check:local-paths && npm run check:translation-coverage && npm run translation:contract:validate && python scripts/check_template_workflow_gate.py --write-report
scripts.reader:static-check: python scripts/check_reader_facing_policy.py --write-report && python scripts/check_reader_navigation.py --write-report && npm run check:bilingual && npm run check:bilingual:interleave
scripts.release:draft: npm run preflight:template && npm run cover:check && npm run reader:check && python scripts/create_release.py --status DRAFT
scripts.release:create: npm run preflight:template && npm run cover:check && npm run reader:check && npm run translation:artifact:release-validate && npm run check:epub && npm run review:random-validate:pass && python scripts/create_release.py --status PASS --require-pass
scripts.build:epub: npm run translation:prebuild && npm run preflight:template && npm run lint:publication && npm run lint:assets && npm run cover:check && node scripts/build_epub.js && npm run build:bilingual && npm run reader:check && npm run check:epub && npm run translation:artifact:validate

description: Book-local npm scripts for English to Simplified Chinese EPUB production. Shared Node dependencies are installed once under books/node_modules and are resolved by walking up from the project root.
